data.title: Hon Kwok Reports Higher Revenue and Core Operating Profit in First-Half 2026-27
data.description:
Hon Kwok Land Investment Co., Ltd. ( (HK:0160) ) has issued an update.

Hon Kwok Land Investment said revenue for the six months ended 30 September 2026 rose 30.3% year on year to HK$570.9 million, while core operating profit increased 7.8% to HK$172.0 million. A net investment-property revaluation markdown of HK$176.5 million compared with HK$285.1 million a year earlier; the company said the non-cash adjustment did not affect operating cash flow.

Contracted sales at Guangzhou’s Riverside exceeded HK$1 billion, mainland commercial occupancy increased at three properties, and by September 2026 occupancy reached 100% at The Bauhinia Hotel (Central) and 87% at The Bauhinia Serviced Apartment; the Kwai Chung data centre continued generating recurring income. The company sold three Japan hotels at premiums to purchase prices, adding liquidity, while the board did not recommend an interim dividend.

data.title: Nanjing Leads Biolabs Enrolls First Patient in Confirmatory Phase III EP-NEC Study
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:9887) ).

Nanjing Leads Biolabs develops innovative biological products, including LBL-024 (opamtistomig), an anti-PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody, for cancer treatment. Its clinical work described here also covers SCLC, BTC, HCC and ovarian cancer.

On Nov. 27, 2026, the first patient was enrolled in a confirmatory, randomized, double-blind, multicenter Phase III study of LBL-024 plus platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced EP-NEC; overall survival is the primary endpoint. The LBL-024 monotherapy NDA for advanced EP-NEC had been accepted by China’s NMPA and included in its priority review and approval procedure, while company-reported studies cited median OS of 8.7 months in later-line EP-NEC and an 18-month OS rate of 55.7% in first-line EP-NEC combination treatment.

data.title: Palasino Reports Interim Results for Six Months Ended September 2026
data.description:
Palasino Holdings Limited ( (HK:2536) ) has issued an update.

For the six months ended 30 September 2026, revenue from gaming, hotel, catering, leasing and related services fell 4% to approximately HK$293.3 million, while gaming revenue declined 7% to approximately HK$204.1 million amid higher energy costs and reduced consumer discretionary spending. Hotel revenue rose 4% to HK$51.9 million, with average daily room rate up 1%, occupancy up 2% and RevPAR up 2%.

Profit attributable to owners fell to approximately HK$7.2 million from approximately HK$11.6 million, while adjusted EBITDA declined to approximately HK$20.9 million from HK$31.2 million. Palasino Mikulov, which commenced operations in late March 2026, remained in its early ramp-up stage; excluding it, profit would have been approximately HK$22.1 million. The Group rolled out customer incentive and loyalty programmes and invested heavily in marketing and promotions, while the Board did not recommend an interim dividend.

data.title: HK.AI Capital Announces Unaudited Results for Six Months Ended 30 September 2026
data.description:
Wealthking Investments Limited ( (HK:1140) ) has issued an update.

HK.AI Capital Limited, formerly known as Wealthink AI-Innovation Capital Limited, is incorporated in the Cayman Islands and reports results for itself and its subsidiaries under stock code 1140. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, the group recorded turnover of HK$634.082 million and revenue of HK$108.238 million, compared with HK$260.769 million and HK$119.549 million, respectively, a year earlier.

The group reported an operating loss of HK$4,147.151 million, compared with an operating profit of HK$245.107 million in the corresponding period, while loss attributable to owners was HK$4,128.291 million versus a profit of HK$70.381 million. Net unrealised losses across the investment categories totaled HK$4,184.422 million, comprising losses on listed investments of HK$3,856.861 million and unlisted investments of HK$354.117 million, partly offset by a HK$26.556 million gain on artworks.
